county_commissioner.title: County Commissioner
controls: County roads and public works outside city limits
Land use and zoning for unincorporated areas
County sheriff's office budget and oversight
Local health department and county-run social services
County property tax levies (within state limits)
does_not_control: City police, roads, or zoning inside incorporated cities
School curriculum or funding (that's the school board / state)

city_councilor.title: City Councilor
controls: City ordinances (noise, parking, local business rules)
City budget: police, fire, parks, local roads, water/sewer
Local zoning and development approval inside city limits
Setting local property tax rates within city boundaries
does_not_control: County roads or unincorporated land outside the city

school_board_member.title: School Board Member
controls: District budget and how per-student funding is spent
Hiring/firing the superintendent
District-level policy (not state-mandated curriculum)
Approving new schools, boundaries, and bond measures
does_not_control: State-mandated graduation requirements or standardized testing rules
Federal education funding rules (Title I, IDEA, etc.)

state_representative.title: State Representative (lower chamber)
controls: State laws and budget (their chamber's half of the legislature)
State tax policy
Oversight of state agencies (DMV, state police, etc.)
Redistricting (with the state senate)

state_senator.title: State Senator (upper chamber)
controls: Same general powers as state reps, plus confirming governor's appointments in most states
State budget (their chamber's half)
State tax and regulatory policy

us_house_rep.title: U.S. House Representative
controls: Federal law (with the Senate and President)
Federal budget - House originates spending bills
Represents their district's specific interests in Congress

us_senator.title: U.S. Senator
controls: Federal law (with the House and President)
Confirms federal judges, cabinet members, and other appointments
Ratifies treaties
